title: speedQOL
description: An over-engineered QOL and performance modpack.
body:
## All for speed and quality ⚡ **speedQOL** _(read as _"speed coil"_)_ is a QOL and performance modpack intended to make your game **less laggy, less buggy** and provide you with **multiple new features** that enhance the vanilla Minecraft experience. **Currently speedQOL is only available for Fabric**, though I am planning to port it over to other mod loaders eventually. Expect Forge and NeoForge soon. ## Features 📄 - Combat system reverted to the one from the [Combat Test snapshots](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_Combat_Tests) - Many bug fixes - Flying in creative mode is faster - FPS optimization - Free world hosting - Serilum's mod bundles - Zooming - Texture improvements for redstone - Competitive ice boat racing physics - Minimap - WorldEdit - Block texture continuity - Smaller held items - Getting XP from crops - Better player and mob animations - Player sitting - Day counter - Helpful subtitles - Improved armor stands from Bedrock Edition - Improved tree harvesting and vein mining - Food-related HUD improvements ## Issues ❓ You can report all issues with the modpack in my Discord server. ## Included packs 📦 _All of the mods and texture packs in this pack come directly from the Modrinth website._
